linkedIn.headline: Interim Financial Due Diligence & Corporate Finance Professional | Ex-Deloitte Assistant Director
linkedIn.about:
Former Deloitte Assistant Director with c.10 years' experience in Financial Due Diligence, supporting private equity, corporate and owner-managed businesses.
 
I have worked on approximately 60 transactions, leading around 20 engagements across buy-side and sell-side due diligence, vendor assist and transaction support.
 
Since leaving Deloitte, I founded and built a profitable consumer products business generating over £5m in revenue, giving me first-hand commercial experience alongside my advisory background.
 
I currently undertake interim Financial Due Diligence and Corporate Finance assignments.

experiences.title: Interim Financial Due Diligence Consultant
experiences.description:
Providing interim financial due diligence and transaction support to private equity-backed and corporate clients.
 
Available for interim and project-based assignments across Financial Due Diligence, Corporate Finance and Transaction Support.

experiences.title: Founder
experiences.company: Shot in the Dark Game Ltd
experiences.description:
Founded the business in 2019 and built it alongside my full-time role at Deloitte before moving full-time into the business from March 2023 to December 2025. The business now operates without day-to-day involvement, enabling me to focus on interim and project-based roles.
  
Built a profitable consumer products business from £1,500 initial capital, generating £5m+ total revenue and £1m+ total net profit to date, while leading commercial strategy, operations, and financial and cash flow management.

experiences.title: Assistant Director
experiences.description: Worked in Transaction Services, providing financial due diligence on acquisitions and disposals for private equity, corporates and owner-managed businesses. Progressed from Associate to Assistant Director.
